purpose: Review additional high-multiplicity component signatures spanning transparent environmental enclosures and anthropomorphic species masks.

records.training_note: Iceklaw separates facial expression/markings from the removable bear muzzle and species silhouette. This is another strong species-mask topology anchor.

systemic_findings: Transparent bubble helmets deserve a dedicated enclosure route distinct from both identity masks and flat facial decoration.
Species-mask signatures repeat heavily across release variants, making them efficient manual-review anchors.
Exact component-signature propagation should continue to transfer only physical topology, not semantic source equivalence.
